==Overview==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Mythic}} unit. He is only obtainable by evolving [[Martial Demon]].
He is also the boss of stage 4 of [[Story#Snowy Town|Snowy Town]] as The Ice Demon.
